query:
SELECT
            src.account_id AS "account_id!",
            src.external_account_id AS "external_account_id!",
            raw.source_deleted AS "source_deleted?",
            raw.source_last_modified_at AS "source_last_modified_at?"
         FROM account_sources src
         LEFT JOIN crm_raw_records raw
           ON raw.organization_id = src.organization_id
          AND raw.id = src.latest_raw_record_id
         WHERE src.organization_id = $1
           AND src.provider = $2::text::crm_provider
           AND src.crm_tenant_id = $3
           AND src.external_account_id = $4
         LIMIT 1
